name: agent_run
description: Launch a configured ctxloom agent as a delegated child session. Async spawn: returns at enqueue with the child's ids (child_agent_id is its harp — its address and continuation token); results, questions, and reports come back as mailbox messages; mail sent to you arrives as context, at your next tool call while you are mid-turn and otherwise as the turn its arrival starts, so there is nothing to poll or wait on. Follow-ups go down with agent_send. Children execute serially (a spawn past the cap queues) and run headless: any permission posture is accepted, and a tool call the posture would prompt for is denied instead — that turn comes back BLOCKED, naming the tool.

input.description: Child task input. `prompt` carries the child's briefing, delivered as its first turn. Optional `workspace` ("none"|"worktree"): "none" runs the child in the parent's live project checkout (it can stomp the parent's files, and sees the parent's uncommitted edits); "worktree" carves the child its own git worktree on its own branch. A worktree checkout only ever sees committed state, so before a new worktree is carved ctxloom commits the parent's uncommitted and untracked changes off-branch and carves the child from that commit, so the child sees them; the parent's branch advances to that commit only once the child has started (a launch that fails leaves it untouched); when the child's run ends, whatever its worktree holds uncommitted is committed on the child's own branch. Empty defers to the project config if it sets one explicitly, otherwise defaults to worktree. This isolates the child's WORKING FILES only — it does not isolate the engine's own global config/credentials/session store from the parent's.

examples.prompt: Review the diff on branch X for correctness bugs

prompt.description: The child's briefing, delivered as its first turn

workspace.description: Where the child's working files live. "none" runs it in the parent's live project checkout (it can stomp the parent's files, and sees the parent's uncommitted edits); "worktree" carves it its own git worktree on its own branch, committing the parent's uncommitted edits first so it sees them. OMIT to defer to the project config, which defaults a delegated child to worktree.

role.description: Configured ctxloom agent name to launch (its composed profiles, engine binding, runtime axis, and permissions are honored; see `ctxloom agent list`)
